whyNotSingleVariable: The recognizers have different architectures and different intrinsic transforms. Arm A consumes the preprocessed PNG at its native size through the WASM Tesseract path; Arm B resizes the same PNG to 32x128 as an unavoidable property of the model. No single dimension separates them, so no causal attribution is claimed.
sharedStartingEvidence: both arms begin from the same frozen preprocessed Brand crop PNG bytes for each OCR item
byteIdenticalTensorsNote: The two models do NOT receive byte-identical tensors. They receive identical source evidence followed by architecture-native processing.

excluded.note: Every entry is false: none of these was used.

retryPolicy: One primary invocation and one exact repeat per arm-item. No retry beyond the fixed repeat, and no altered setting after output exists.
